dimensions.assessment: Involves ten federal departments and agencies, state attorneys general, local law enforcement, consumer advocacy groups, and multiple private industry sectors.
dimensions.evidence: task force convened under subsection (a) shall include representatives from each of the following... Department of Homeland Security... Department of Justice

dimensions.assessment: Aims to coordinate national strategy, public education, enforcement actions, and systemic risk reduction related to consumer scams and financial fraud.
dimensions.evidence: develop and implement a national strategy to address scams that includes... public education... enforcement actions using existing authorities

dimensions.assessment: The source text does not specify appropriations or direct financial allocations for the task force.
Broad interagency coordination mandate spanning multiple cabinets, regulatory bodies, reporting obligations, and private sector consultations.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Federal Trade Commission, in conjunction with the Department of Justice, to convene an interagency task force

dimensions.assessment: The interagency task force operates for a duration of ten years before terminating.
dimensions.evidence: The task force convened under subsection (a) shall terminate on the date that is 10 years after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Funding amounts or budgetary impact for operating the interagency task force and implementing its strategy.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs multiple federal agencies to convene an interagency task force to build and implement a national strategy addressing scams, consulting with industry and public entities over a ten-year lifespan.
